caption:
Gemini 3.8 Live processes visual inputs in near real time and supports 97 languages with automatic switching. It executes background tool calls during conversations. The blog post makes no claims about voice call summaries or time savings.

How it works:
1. Share documents during meetings.
2. Gemini processes visual content near real-time.
3. Get summaries of shared visuals.

This works for any visual input (PDFs, slides, images) during meetings. No voice call features.
